svg.title: What the checks of a Nextcloud app take from a cache
svg.desc: The downloads of Composer, pip and npm come from caches under a key of their lock files, and the tools check them against the lock. php-cs-fixer starts from its cache and checks every file whose content changed. Psalm and its taint analysis use no cache and read the public API of Nextcloud ahead, everything else through the autoloader.
